prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1402; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a side impact collision at a signalized intersection. Claimant reports being struck on the driver side by a vehicle that entered on a red signal. Claimant states a knee injury from contact with the door frame and is seeking medical evaluation. Claimant is not represented by counsel. Initial contact made by phone; recorded statement scheduled.

Entry 2: Recorded statement taken from claimant. Claimant describes proceeding through the intersection on a green light and being struck by the other vehicle's front passenger side. Claimant reports pain in the right knee and difficulty bending it. Claimant confirms no attorney has been retained and asks about the claims process. Explained the general steps for medical documentation and vehicle inspection.

Entry 3: Scene photos and the police report requested. Report lists both drivers as cited for signal violations pending review. Other driver's insurer contacted to confirm liability position; their adjuster indicates liability is under review. Vehicle damage to claimant's vehicle appears consistent with a side impact on the driver door and rear quarter panel.

Entry 4: Claimant provided urgent care records showing a knee sprain with swelling and a recommendation for follow-up with an orthopedic provider. Claimant reports ongoing pain when climbing stairs. Advised claimant to keep all treatment appointments and retain receipts for out-of-pocket medical costs. Rental vehicle coverage reviewed with claimant; claimant has requested a replacement vehicle while the car is in repair.

Entry 5: Vehicle inspection completed at the body shop. Estimate received and under review for structural and door panel repairs. Orthopedic referral confirmed; claimant has an appointment scheduled. Medical records request sent to the treating provider with the claimant's signed authorization. Claim remains open pending medical updates and liability determination. Next review scheduled after the orthopedic visit.
